user_query: I'm planning a company event and I need to order some supplies. Can you provide me with a list of products and their availability? It would be helpful to see the details of each product as well.

TaskList.description: Query the inventory database to retrieve a list of available products for ordering supplies.
Gather detailed information for each product including descriptions, prices, and stock levels.
Compile the gathered product details into a user-friendly format for review.
